agenda.topic: A short presentation about the SEM and how it will be conducted.
agenda.source_requirement: All process owners/dept representatives
agenda.required_action: OEM presentation/scoring/conclusion is authored by the actual issuer/auditor. Upload issued result; portal may draft agenda, minutes and action tracker only.

agenda.topic: Facility to be audited and group information
agenda.source_requirement: Can cover chapter 1 info. like ownership , ownership structure, supplier locations, customers, segments etc..
agenda.required_action: Controlled draft/index plus actual approved records and evidence links; audit coverage not verified.

agenda.topic: Visit the production/similar line production process
agenda.source_requirement:
Plant tour - overview of processes from incoming to packaging & dispatch. 
Covering Production management and Production support in SEM chapter 7
agenda.required_action: Controlled draft/index plus actual approved records and evidence links; audit coverage not verified.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Share holding pattern of plant & JV partners individually if any at micro level. 
E.g. Citi bank Pension fund - 7.5%; Person A - 30% etc. 
- If any company holds major share, need share holding pattern for that company as well.
- Joint Venture if any scope/responsibilities
- Succession planning when few persons own the business
- Business plan, Investment made in plant/company for the past 3 years
agenda.required_action: Generate profile/business/KPI summaries from verified masters and actual financial records; attach corporate/JV/ownership originals and restrict financial details.

agenda.source_requirement: Location of plants including parent company with scope of responsibilities, warehouse, dealer/distributor etc across the globe & their scope of activities
agenda.required_action: Generate profile/business/KPI summaries from verified masters and actual financial records; attach corporate/JV/ownership originals and restrict financial details.

agenda.source_requirement:
% of contribution by your current customers in your turnover for the last 2 years;  Existing supplier needs to provide OEM's share as well.
e.g. Turnover USD 100;Customer A -10%, Customer B - 12% up to top 5 customers including OEM
- Group level (Overall Level)
agenda.required_action: Generate profile/business/KPI summaries from verified masters and actual financial records; attach corporate/JV/ownership originals and restrict financial details.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Business plan/strategy (3-5 years) & % investment on plant/company
- Organization chart
- Roles & responsibilities of personnel participating making business plan
- Modern systems implementation - 6 Sigma,Lean,TQM,TPM etc                                    
- Company KPIs summary (balanced scorecard or similar)
agenda.required_action: Generate profile/business/KPI summaries from verified masters and actual financial records; attach corporate/JV/ownership originals and restrict financial details.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Trend for 2 -3 years - parameter wise as well as customer wise & improvement action plan
- Filled in questionnaire
- If no questioners are sent out to customers, how is customer satisfaction data received and what actions are taken?
agenda.required_action: Generate support/communication/service report and trends from verified tickets, deliveries, warranty and financial sources; upload signed OEM agreements and actual feedback. Confirm remanufacturing applicability.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Cyber Security risk analysis and what protection system exist today
- Appointment person responsible for Cyber security
- Process in place to prevent phishing
- Awareness of ISO270000 Known recognized anti-virus program in use
- Password rules (Complexity of password and how often to change) 
- Training program in place
-  Mitigation plan in case of Cyber attack
- Backup system (Servers: Virtual, different locations, Safe area)
- External support (Specialist company)
- VPN (Working out of office) guidelines 
- Policy
- Scanning on regular basis and how to use the information from scanning
agenda.required_action: Draft cyber policies, risk/review and training templates. Upload actual scan results, backup/recovery evidence and third-party support agreement. A policy is not proof a control is operating.

agenda.source_requirement:
-Procedure for risk management functions involved
-Risk assessment (Review of current risk assessment. (Evidence of regular updates)
- Mitigation plan connected to the risk assessment.
Examples of risks to be reviewed: Fire protection natural hazards, insurances, alternative production, facility security, liability coverage, environmental risks, own and customer owned tooling's, power supply and energy risks, supplier risks etc.
agenda.required_action: Risk and mitigation register from owner assessments; upload insurance, facility/emergency/vendor evidence. No invented risk scores.

agenda.source_requirement: List All Personal for customer Contact/support - Sales, Quality, Delivery, Engineering, Operations (OEM Team Review)
agenda.required_action: Generate support/communication/service report and trends from verified tickets, deliveries, warranty and financial sources; upload signed OEM agreements and actual feedback. Confirm remanufacturing applicability.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Employee Turnover last three yrs.
- Employee satisfaction reports including participation rate
- Evidence of action plan
agenda.required_action: Restricted HR skill/training/turnover/satisfaction reports from actual employee, attendance and survey responses; retain participation denominator and evidence.

agenda.source_requirement:
- ISO 14001 Certificate copy / Time plan to achieve
- Previous audit observations / NC details
- KPIs tracked
agenda.required_action: Upload authentic certificate if issued; otherwise record actual certification plan. Generate expiry/status tracker only. Never create a certificate or claim certification.

agenda.source_requirement: QMS Certificate / Time plan to achieve
agenda.required_action: Upload authentic certificate if issued; otherwise record actual certification plan. Generate expiry/status tracker only. Never create a certificate or claim certification.

agenda.source_requirement:
- RFQ review process
- Quality Targets setting for new projects,
- Lessons learnt (Things Gone Right & Things Gone Wrong),
- APQP, controls & reviews
- PFMEA, guidelines
- Control Plan, guidelines
- Pre Production Controls check,PPAP file
- Ramp up procedure, process audit plan & report, Safety stock
agenda.required_action: Generate linked APQP/FMEA/control-plan/problem-solving drafts. Require actual reviews, measurements, action effectiveness, PPAP and current revision evidence.

agenda.source_requirement: - Customer PPM (0 KM) and trend Vs Customer target for last 3 years
agenda.required_action: Generate production/capacity/delivery/PPM trend reports from actual counts and dates. Define denominators/time windows; upload actual inspections/calibration/production evidence.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Fault frequency calculation
- Warranty cost/cost of poor quality result and trend
- Support on field issues, past recall, action taken if any
agenda.required_action: Generate support/communication/service report and trends from verified tickets, deliveries, warranty and financial sources; upload signed OEM agreements and actual feedback. Confirm remanufacturing applicability.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Customer complaint data base review
- Procedure to make root cause analyses + example from complaints picked by auditor
- Efficiency of actions (repeated problems?)
- Updates of documents like P-FMEA, control plan, work instructions etc.
- Rules for answering time of customer complaints and result
agenda.required_action: Generate linked APQP/FMEA/control-plan/problem-solving drafts. Require actual reviews, measurements, action effectiveness, PPAP and current revision evidence.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Determination of special characteristics
- Identification of special characteristics, drawings, FMEA, control plan, work instructions
- Internal rules for a capable process, Cp, Cpk 
- Management of supplier special characteristics
agenda.required_action: Generate linked APQP/FMEA/control-plan/problem-solving drafts. Require actual reviews, measurements, action effectiveness, PPAP and current revision evidence.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Long term capacity forecast
- Production planning. Review how production planning is done with tools used
- Capacity calculation model (OEE or similar calculation)
- Bottleneck analyses and action on short and long term
agenda.required_action: Generate production/capacity/delivery/PPM trend reports from actual counts and dates. Define denominators/time windows; upload actual inspections/calibration/production evidence.

agenda.source_requirement: Trend for 2-3 years for major customer, with customer targets
agenda.required_action: Generate production/capacity/delivery/PPM trend reports from actual counts and dates. Define denominators/time windows; upload actual inspections/calibration/production evidence.

agenda.source_requirement: EDI as per OEM's requirements
agenda.required_action: Record actual OEM EDI requirement/confirmation and transmission evidence. A generated document cannot substitute for EDI integration.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Policy on spare part support (duration & pricing) after serial production ends 
- Production methods that will be used
- Any agreement signed with OEM? (Framework, general conditions, price agreement)
- Delivery/Quality performance trend
agenda.required_action: Generate support/communication/service report and trends from verified tickets, deliveries, warranty and financial sources; upload signed OEM agreements and actual feedback. Confirm remanufacturing applicability.

agenda.source_requirement: Policy to create service literature and examples if applicable as start the sentence.
agenda.required_action: Generate support/communication/service report and trends from verified tickets, deliveries, warranty and financial sources; upload signed OEM agreements and actual feedback. Confirm remanufacturing applicability.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Procedure for remanufacturing if applicable, visit to reman area
- Policy on reman parts (warranty)
- Any trend of performance remanufactured parts
agenda.required_action: Generate support/communication/service report and trends from verified tickets, deliveries, warranty and financial sources; upload signed OEM agreements and actual feedback. Confirm remanufacturing applicability.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Target for training, target Vs actual for last 3 years
- How training needs are identified
- Effectiveness of trainings
- Qualification process for special process
- Skill matrix, training need identification, and sufficient back-up in place
agenda.required_action: Restricted HR skill/training/turnover/satisfaction reports from actual employee, attendance and survey responses; retain participation denominator and evidence.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Incoming inspection Process including FIFO management
- WIP Management
- Work Instructions & Daily start up checks
- Final inspection, Packaging/final storage including FIFO management
agenda.required_action: Generate production/capacity/delivery/PPM trend reports from actual counts and dates. Define denominators/time windows; upload actual inspections/calibration/production evidence.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Defect/NC part management process on shop floor
- Poka yokes implemented and check for effectiveness
- In house ppm trend product wise for 3 years
- Gage Calibration Program and floor Review 
- Visual management + daily meeting structure 
- Housekeeping (5S audits?)
agenda.required_action: Generate production/capacity/delivery/PPM trend reports from actual counts and dates. Define denominators/time windows; upload actual inspections/calibration/production evidence.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Preventive & Predictive Maintenance Plan Vs actual
- Review of maintenance instructions
- External maintenance records and agreements
- Spare part identification & stock monitoring
agenda.required_action: Generate maintenance schedule and plan-versus-actual from actual assets/work orders; upload external maintenance reports/agreements and evidence.

agenda.topic: Change management with focus on process changes
agenda.source_requirement:
- Procedure of change management with focus on process changes and customer communication
- Traceability of implemented process changes
- Process change planning and how well in advance customer is informed
- Team approach, which functions are involved
- Procedure how sub supplier changes are managed
agenda.required_action: Controlled process-change draft and implementation traceability; attach actual customer notification/approval and supplier-change evidence.

agenda.topic: Product development process (If design is in your scope)

- Project Management process including milestones and gate reviews- 
- List of customers, Industrial segments served
- Technology roadmap
- Project tracking and KPIs
agenda.required_action: Generate project/spec/review/prototype summaries from actual records. Upload EDA/CAD/simulation/test-tool artifacts, supplier/lab evidence and original requirements.

agenda.topic: Product engineering technology (If design is in your scope)

- List of computer aided systems 
- Risk analysis tools - e.g. DFMEA
- Simulations and virtual verification capabilities
- Document control, security of transmission
agenda.required_action: Generate project/spec/review/prototype summaries from actual records. Upload EDA/CAD/simulation/test-tool artifacts, supplier/lab evidence and original requirements.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Process of making prototypes - methods,inhouse/outsourced/Rapid Prototyping, production line/offline
- Delivery performance trend of prototypes
- Description test facilities in-house & outsourced
agenda.required_action: Generate project/spec/review/prototype summaries from actual records. Upload EDA/CAD/simulation/test-tool artifacts, supplier/lab evidence and original requirements.

agenda.topic: R&D (If design is in your scope)

- Trend of Spent on R & D as a % of turnover for the last 3 years

agenda.source_requirement:
Explanation on OEM' score card
(Supplier finance data evaluated by OEM finance expert team, based on the data submitted during Short SEM)
agenda.required_action: Generate verified R&D-spend ratios with period/denominator reconciliation; OEM financial score remains externally authored. Historical actuals must be supplied.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Continuous Improvement Leader and Cross Functional Team Development                                      
 - Continual improvement activities including process description
- Trend for last 3 years - Target Vs actual
- Management involvement in CI activities
agenda.required_action: Generate improvement charter/action/trend drafts from actual baselines, targets and results; human validation and source periods required.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Supplier evaluation process (for new potential suppliers)
- Supplier selection process & agreements
- APQP and PPAP procedure for suppliers
- Tier2 supplier capacity management
agenda.required_action: Generate supplier selection/evaluation/performance/SCAR templates and calculations from actual records; upload supplier agreements, audit evidence and supplied PPAP.

agenda.source_requirement:
- Supplier performance monitoring process

- Supplier audits, plan Vs actual
